name: Ootori Yuuka
source:
"I'll never forgive molesters!"

A passionate policewoman with a love for justice. She hates crime, especially more despicable acts like molestation.

To date, Yuka has arrested many molesters, with Tetsuo being one particular molester she keeps an eye on.

However, as she cracks down on molesters, she gradually begins to desire being molested herself. She has started to secretly masturbate while fantasizing about it.
